description: Bowline — standalone CLI + browser UI for the multi-protocol API workbench. Discover, invoke, record, mock, and replay across gRPC, REST, GraphQL, MQTT, SignalR, WebSocket, SSE, MCP, OData, and Socket.IO — every first-party plugin pre-bundled. Run `bowline --url …` for the browser UI or `bowline list/describe/call` / `bowline mock` for grpcurl-style scripting and recording replay.
